# CANDIDATE: VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_ORB_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
Low volatility contraction precedes expansion; a breakout of the opening range after such contraction yields higher follow‑through. The ATR-based volatility compression filter identifies periods of suppressed range that often precede explosive moves, increasing the probability of successful ORB breakouts.

## Mechanism
Entry rule: If the 5‑minute ATR(5) is below its 20‑period low for three consecutive bars (volatility compression) and price then breaks above the opening‑range high (ORH) on a bar with volume > 1.5× the average 5‑minute volume of the first 30 minutes, enter long at the breakout bar’s close. Exit shape: Chart‑stop at ORH (invalidation), TP1 at 2R (measured from entry to ORH), runner trail using ATR(10)×2 trailing stop. Regime hint: VIX between 15‑30, time after 10:00 EST (post‑open).
